create.name: Dharma Gates
create.bio:
Dharma Gates is a US nonprofit that helps adults aged roughly 18 to 35 find their way into serious meditation practice. It began as a student meditation group at Wesleyan University, and Aaron Stryker, who has trained in Zen, in month-long retreats in the Pa Auk style and in the Nyingma Dudjom Tersar line, has led it as executive director since 2019. Rather than teaching a single lineage, it partners with Buddhist teachers and practice centres across the Zen, Theravada and Tibetan traditions, bringing young practitioners to monasteries and retreat houses they might not otherwise reach.

Every programme is offered on a dana basis: there are no fees or suggested amounts, and the organisation covers food, lodging and teacher costs. Its calendar mixes week-long silent retreats, half-day and single-day events in New York City and at universities, and online courses, and it runs a donation-based advising service for people weighing residential training or monastic life. Since 2020 its YouTube channel has carried long-form conversations with teachers and monastics about their training, alongside talks given on its retreats; it also produces a podcast.

courses.title: Dancing in Fire: Wisdom and Compassion Practices (NYC half-day event with Megan Mook)
courses.description: An afternoon of practice, reflection and conversation in New York City for young adults, led by the Tibetan Buddhist teacher Megan Mook. It centres on wisdom and compassion practices for meeting a troubled world.

courses.title: There Is Always This: Cultivating Zen Meditation and Vision with Jogen Salzberg
courses.description: Six days of focused Zen sitting, teaching and enquiry at Bell's Mountain Dharma Center for practitioners aged 18 to 35. Offered as a gift, with costs covered by the organisation.

courses.title: Living a Zen Path with Danica Shoan Ankele, Sensei and Gokan Bonebakker, Osho
courses.description: A young adult retreat with two Zen teachers on finding the mind's natural clarity and carrying it into ordinary life, suited to those starting out. Places are offered on a donation basis.

courses.title: Monastic Advising
courses.description: One-to-one conversations for anyone thinking about residential training or monastic life, with guidance on choosing a trustworthy practice centre that fits their background and aims. Offered on a donation basis after an interest form.
